title: POST-007 Phase 3: Physical Engineering Truth & Industrial Superiority Charter
foundational_shift: Transitioning from algorithmic simulation to Cyber-Physical Engineering Truth OS. Verification is anchored in physical reality, empirical telemetry, independent reference datasets, and zero-loss end-to-end digital-physical thread accounting.

track_a_gap_closure.focus: Closing the 5 empirical/hardware gaps exposed in CAP-SUP-005 without reopening already-proven analytical contracts

work_packages.name: Real Metrology Acquisition & Hardware Driver Protocol Interface
work_packages.gap_addressed: Eliminating SIMULATED_PHYSICAL_ACQUISITION via structured CMM / optical scanner protocol drivers with live calibration validity and GUM uncertainty.

work_packages.name: Empirical Tool-Wear Validation & Sensor Telemetry Dataset Integration
reference_standards: ISO 3685:1993 (Tool-life testing with single-point turning tools)
work_packages.gap_addressed: Moving beyond synthetic Usui flank wear to empirical cutting datasets (spindle load, feed force, vibration, tool wear microscope ground truth).

work_packages.name: Closed Physical Loop Machining & Re-Measurement Cycle
reference_standards: NIST Digital Thread Closed-Loop Manufacturing Architecture
work_packages.gap_addressed: End-to-end physical trial: CAD REV-A -> CAM -> Machining -> Physical CMM -> QIF -> Inversion -> REV-B -> Re-machining -> Residual convergence.

work_packages.name: Independent External Reference Benchmark & Oracle Separation
work_packages.gap_addressed: Validating SECP algorithms against externally certified reference datasets and independent external oracles rather than internal self-consistency.

work_packages.name: Machine Execution Safety Contract & Controller Gateway
work_packages.gap_addressed: Pre-execution cryptographic handshake: machine kinematics, controller identity, fixture coordinates, work offsets (G54-G59), limits, and rollback capability.

track_b_end_to_end_superiority.focus: Architecting and mathematically verifying the unbroken 16-stage Cyber-Physical Lifecycle with strict 11-dimensional Loss Accounting across every boundary
lifecycle_thread_stages: STAGE-02: Canonical CAD (Watertight Manifold B-Rep Solid)
STAGE-03: Semantic PMI / GD&T (ISO 1101 / ASME Y14.5)
STAGE-15: Canonical Revision Proposal & Provenance Rollback
STAGE-16: Re-Manufacturing & Digital Twin Health State

loss_accounting_dimensions.definition: Loss of entity UID (face, edge, vertex, feature, tolerance) during file transfer or regeneration.
Loss of intent, datum references, or GD&T relationships during conversion.
loss_accounting_dimensions.target: ZERO_TOLERANCE (100% semantic preservation via formal semantic AST)

loss_accounting_dimensions.definition: Shape approximation or discretization errors (e.g. meshing chordal deviation).
Floating point round-off, truncation, or solver precision degradation.
Dropping or ignoring measurement uncertainty bounds during decision making.
Severing the cryptographic chain of custody, authorship, or time-stamping.
Applying data or compensation derived from Revision X onto Revision Y.
Loss of sequence order, calibration validity intervals, or telemetry timestamps.
Confusion between Machine Coordinate System (MCS), Workpiece (WCS), or Sensor Frame.
Implicit imperial/metric conversions or dimensional inconsistency.
loss_accounting_dimensions.target: ZERO_TOLERANCE (Canonical SI units enforced at boundary)

loss_accounting_dimensions.definition: Automated execution without required engineering role sign-off or governance token.

metrics_philosophy.true_metric: Capability -> Evidence -> Independent Verification -> Physical Validation -> Repeatability -> Traceability -> Zero Boundary Loss
